content.short: Privasea is a privacy-preserving AI compute network using FHE to process encrypted data without decryption.
content.description: Privasea is a pioneering Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) designed to provide high-performance AI compute power while maintaining total data privacy. Utilizing advanced Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) technology, the platform enables AI models to perform complex computations on encrypted data without ever decrypting it. This ensures that sensitive information remains completely secure and inaccessible to compute providers. Designed for AI developers, Privasea provides a scalable alternative to centralized cloud services for processing regulated data.
